senses.gloss: औशन [auśana] औशनस [auśanasa], औशनस a. (-नी, -सी f.) [उशनस्-अण्] Belonging or peculiar to Uśanas; originating from Uśanas, or taught by him; पितामहाद्वरं लेभे सर्वमौशनसं धनम् Rām.4.51.13.
सम् The law-book of उशनस् (a treatise on civil polity).
N. of an Upapurāṇa.-साः N. of a school of writers on the science of government mentioned by Kauṭilya; Kau. A.1.15.-सी N. of Devayanī; तं वीरमाहौशनसी प्रेमनिर्भरया गिरा Bhāg.9.18.2.
औषणम् [auṣaṇam], [उषण्-अण्]
Pungency.
Black pepper. -Comp. -शौण्डी dried ginger; black pepper.
औषध [auṣadha], a. (-धी f.) [औषधि-अण्] Consisting of herbs.
धम् A herb; herbs taken collectively.
A medicament, medicinal drug, medicine in general.
A vessel for herbs.
A mineral.
N. of Viṣṇu.
Counter-action, prevention; अतिक्रुधं निषधमनौषधं जनः Śi.17.7. -Comp. -पेषकः One who grinds or pounds medicaments.
औषधिः [auṣadhiḥ] धी [dhī], धी f.
A herb, plant (in general); Y.3.276 v. l.; see ओषधि.
A medicinal herb; अचिन्त्यो हि मणिमन्त्रौषधीनां प्रभावः Ratn.2.
An herb which emits fire; विरमन्ति न ज्वलितुमौषधयः Ki.5.24 (तृण- ज्योतीषि Malli.); cf. Ku.1.1.
An annual or deciduous plant; ˚धीपतिः N. of Soma, the lord of plants.-पञ्चप्रकाराः (1) Juice of green herb (रस). (2) Powderक
औषधीकृ [auṣadhīkṛ], 8 U. To reduce to a medicament.
औषधीय [auṣadhīya], a. Medicinal, consisting of herbs.
औषरम् [auṣaram] रकम् [rakam], रकम् [उषरे भवं अण्, ततः कन्]
Rock-salt.
Iron stone.
औषस [auṣasa], a. (-सी f.) [उषस्-अण्] Relating to dawn, early; ˚आतप Ki.9.11. -सी Day-break, morning.
औषसिक [auṣasika] औषिक [auṣika], औषिक a. (-की f.)
Walking out at day-break.
Early born or produced at dawn.
औषस्य [auṣasya], a. Sacred to Uṣas or the dawn.
